+> What is the Training fee?
For 3 Months internship period the training Fee is INR 350 (One Time Fee)
(This is the only payment there is no need of any payment for accessing any resources from
[Provider] like courses, materials etc. The fee is fully reinvested in your development. [Provider] does
not keep any part of it.)
> Purpose
As outlined in our application form, a nominal fee for live training and learning platform access is
required as a commitment to effectively utilize our resources and successfully complete your
internship. We invest significantly in our internship program to provide you with a top-quality
experience, and this small fee helps us maintain the high standards of our offerings.
Se This Fee Inludes:
1. Live training from starting of your internship to end, by industry experts
2. [Provider] learning Platform Access
3. Training and Learning Materials
4. Training session Recording Access anytime
5. 24/7 Support for any issue related to your internship.
a Internship Details
1, Start Date: 20-March-2025
2. Weekly Hours: Flexible working hours |
3. Compensation: INR 1000- 5000/Month based on performance (Indian currency
4. Location: Remote/Work From Home


+ Refund Policy
Upon successful completion of the internship and exceptional performance, this fee will be
refunded as part of your stipend.

> Acceptance
Accepting our offer is entirely up to you. Should you be interested in the program and decide to
‘come aboard, you'll be welcomed into our dynamic team of developers. Otherwise, you can simply
drop the offer

+ Misconception
The fee is not for internship* it's for the live training & learning platform access. On basis of your
attendance, active participation, project performance etc it will be refunded

> Job Assistance
At [Provider], we are committed to your professional growth and future employment. Upon
successful completion of the internship, you will receive 100% job assistance to help you secure a
role aligned with your skills and expertise.
We will assess your progress throughout the program to ensure you are industry-ready. The training
fee is a nominal part of your commitment to this journey, aimed at enhancing your skills and
preparing you for career opportunities.
